+# Architecture
+
+**Goal:** Build a Q&A forum: questions with title, details and author, answers to each question, upvote questions and answers, sort by top or newest
+
+**Preset:** fastapi-vanilla
+
+2 SQLite tables (questions and answers) with one database module each; every module's schema creates all tables. FastAPI routers, one per resource. Counters are owned by the server and change only through action endpoints; lists are ordered by the query field sort. A multi-page app (dashboard, a page per resource, a detail page) is served from static/.
+
+## Product spec
+
+### Q&A Forum
+
+Share questions with details, answer them, upvote questions and answers, and sort by top or newest.
+
+**questions**: title (string), content (string), author (string), upvotes (integer). Operations: list, create, update, delete. Actions: upvote (upvotes). Sort: new / top.
+**answers**: content (string), author (string), upvotes (integer). Operations: list, create, update, delete. Belongs to questions. Actions: upvote (upvotes). Sort: new / top.
+
+Features:
+- Form to ask a question with title and content
+- List of questions with title, author, and upvote button
+- Open a question to see answers and add one
+- Form to answer a question with content
+- List of answers with author and upvote button
+- Edit and Delete buttons on questions and answers
+- Sort the list by Newest or Top
+
+## Endpoints
+- `GET /api/questions`: List all questions, newest first or by score
+- `POST /api/questions`: Add a question
+- `PUT /api/questions/{id}`: Edit one question
+- `DELETE /api/questions/{id}`: Delete one question and its answers
+- `POST /api/questions/{id}/upvote`: Upvote one question: adds 1 to upvotes and return the updated question
+- `GET /api/questions/{question_id}/answers`: List the answers of one question
+- `POST /api/questions/{question_id}/answers`: Add a answer to a question
+- `PUT /api/answers/{id}`: Edit one answer
+- `DELETE /api/answers/{id}`: Delete one answer
+- `POST /api/answers/{id}/upvote`: Upvote one answer: adds 1 to upvotes and return the updated answer
+
+## Web page must
+- Form to add a question with title, content, author
+- List of questions showing every field and a Score line, with vote buttons that show the counts
+- Sort select (Newest or Top) for the questions
+- Edit and Delete buttons on every question
+- Form to add a answer with content, author (inside the open parent)
+- List of answers showing every field and a Score line, with vote buttons that show the counts
+- Sort select (Newest or Top) for the answers
+- Click a question (Comments button) to open its answers with a form to add one

+# Database schema
+
+SQLite. Connections come from `database.connection.get_conn()` (a `sqlite3.Row` factory).
+
+## Table `questions`
+
+- `id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT
+- `title` TEXT NOT NULL
+- `content` TEXT NOT NULL
+- `author` TEXT NOT NULL
+- `upvotes` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
+- `created_at` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
+
+## Table `answers`
+
+- `id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT
+- `question_id` INTEGER NOT NULL
+- `content` TEXT NOT NULL
+- `author` TEXT NOT NULL
+- `upvotes` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
+- `created_at` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
+
+## Data access functions (module chosen by the Database engineer, exported from `database/`)
+
+- `add_question(title: str, content: str, author: str) -> dict`: Inserts a row with these values and returns the new row as a dict (SELECT * FROM the table WHERE id = lastrowid: always SELECT *, so created_at and the counters come back too). Counters and created_at come from their column defaults.
+- `get_question(question_id: int) -> dict | None`: Returns the row as a dict (SELECT *), or None if the id does not exist.
+- `list_questions(sort: str = "new") -> list[dict]`: Returns every row, as a list of dicts, ordered sort='new' (the default): newest first (ORDER BY id DESC, never created_at); sort='top': highest score first (ORDER BY upvotes DESC, id DESC).
+- `update_question(question_id: int, title: str, content: str, author: str) -> dict | None`: Updates the user-entered columns of the row (never counters or created_at) and returns the updated row, or None if the id does not exist.
+- `delete_question(question_id: int) -> bool`: First deletes every row of its children (DELETE FROM answers WHERE question_id = ?; every module's SCHEMA creates all tables), then deletes the row. Returns True if the row existed, else False.
+- `upvote_question(question_id: int) -> dict | None`: Runs UPDATE questions SET upvotes = upvotes + 1 WHERE id = ? and returns the updated row as a dict, or None if the id does not exist.
+- `add_answer(question_id: int, content: str, author: str) -> dict`: Inserts a row with these values and returns the new row as a dict (SELECT * FROM the table WHERE id = lastrowid: always SELECT *, so created_at and the counters come back too). Counters and created_at come from their column defaults.
+- `get_answer(answer_id: int) -> dict | None`: Returns the row as a dict (SELECT *), or None if the id does not exist.
+- `list_answers(question_id: int, sort: str = "new") -> list[dict]`: Returns the rows whose question_id equals the argument (WHERE question_id = ?), as a list of dicts, ordered sort='new' (the default): newest first (ORDER BY id DESC, never created_at); sort='top': highest score first (ORDER BY upvotes DESC, id DESC).
+- `update_answer(answer_id: int, content: str, author: str) -> dict | None`: Updates the user-entered columns of the row (never counters or created_at) and returns the updated row, or None if the id does not exist.
+- `delete_answer(answer_id: int) -> bool`: Deletes the row. Returns True if the row existed, else False.
+- `upvote_answer(answer_id: int) -> dict | None`: Runs UPDATE answers SET upvotes = upvotes + 1 WHERE id = ? and returns the updated row as a dict, or None if the id does not exist.
